summary: Iteration 8 (TypeScript migration regression / smoke test) PASSED. Frontend bundle compiles via webpack and the app renders normally despite three non-blocking TS type-check errors in dev console (cannot resolve `@/pages/Profile`, `@/pages/BookingDetail`, `@/pages/Admin` — all still .jsx). Browse page (now TypeScript) is fully functional with all filters, view modes, and featured badge ordering working. Login/Dashboard/Profile/ToolDetail (incl. 'both' listing buy button) all behave as before. Admin dashboard's 5 tabs (Users/Bookings/Tools/Email log/Reviews) all render and Reviews tab shows 3 hide buttons. EN/FR/ES language switching works across all pages with proper translations. Backend regression: 14/14 pytest iter7 suite still passes + new iter8 regression suite 5/5 (1 skip for ended-booking dedupe — no eligible bookings exist after iter7 cleanup).

ts_compile_warnings.error: TS2307: Cannot find module '@/pages/Profile' or its corresponding type declarations.
ts_compile_warnings.note: Type-check error only; webpack still resolves the .jsx file at runtime. Likely root cause: tsconfig `paths` alias with `allowJs:true` does not resolve .jsx through the `@/*` alias for TypeScript type-checking. Suggested fix: either (a) add `moduleSuffixes` / explicit `.jsx` extension to tsconfig or simpler (b) add a tiny `.d.ts` shim like `declare module '@/pages/Profile'; declare module '@/pages/BookingDetail'; declare module '@/pages/Admin';` in `src/globals.d.ts` until those files are migrated to .tsx.

critical_code_review_comments: TS2307 module-resolution errors for `@/pages/*.jsx` are visible in `/var/log/supervisor/frontend.err.log` and would clutter the IDE / CI. Root cause is the combination of `paths: {"@/*":["*"]}` + `allowJs:true` — TypeScript's path resolver only picks up `.ts/.tsx` by default. Easiest non-invasive fix: append three `declare module '@/pages/Profile';` shims to `src/globals.d.ts`. Long-term fix: migrate those pages to `.tsx` (which is the whole point of this incremental migration anyway).

tsconfig.json has `noEmit:true` and CRA's webpack still uses babel-loader so TS errors are emitted by ForkTsCheckerWebpackPlugin but DO NOT block the bundle. Runtime is unaffected, but this means developers will see persistent red errors in the terminal during `yarn start` — worth fixing.

Browse.tsx successfully consumes Tool / ListingType types from `@/types` and the typed `api` wrapper from `@/lib/api`. Featured-first ordering, 3 view modes (split/grid/map), and the geolocation prompt all work — migration was clean.

Login.jsx data-testids are `login-email`, `login-password`, `login-submit` (not `login-email-input` etc as suggested in the review request). This is a documentation issue only — no fix needed, but worth noting for future testing agents.
Dashboard tab testids are `tab-listings`, `tab-renter`, `tab-owner`, `tab-favorites` (not `dashboard-tab-*`). Inconsistent with admin-tab-* prefix — minor naming consistency issue.
action_items: OPTIONAL — Eliminate the three TS2307 dev-console errors by either: (a) adding `declare module '@/pages/Profile';`, `declare module '@/pages/BookingDetail';`, `declare module '@/pages/Admin';` to `src/globals.d.ts`, or (b) migrating Profile.jsx, BookingDetail.jsx, Admin.jsx to .tsx. The runtime is unaffected so this is non-blocking, but it pollutes the dev terminal.

rca of the issue: No bugs found. The only minor finding is cosmetic TS2307 errors at App.tsx:15/17/19 — these are TypeScript type-checker errors caused by the `@/*` path alias not resolving .jsx files when `allowJs:true` is set without explicit module declarations. They do NOT block runtime; webpack still resolves them correctly via babel-loader. Mitigation is a 3-line addition to `src/globals.d.ts` (see action items).
